scope: Actual presentation methods with declared bond/grip/progress and nested-transform fixtures. No gameplay absorption, completion receipt, mass transfer, controller or perceptual claim.

checks.name: held zero-progress bond stays quiet and creates no intake fragments
current owner progress advance permits intake fragments
stalled or decaying progress emits no new fragments
inactive or incompatible bond cannot authorize intake visuals
first observation and target switch do not interpret existing progress as fresh
line connects target world position to Core world position
funnel and filament endpoints use the Core world position
traveling fragments converge on Core world position
grip preview clears a stale legacy stream and never counts as absorption
hidden and absorbed bodies cannot retain an intake stream
release hides graphics; rehold does not replay stored progress
unknown progress cannot establish a false advance on recovery
presentation never changes owner progress, target transform, mass or credit
